expected_memories.content_gist: Requirement 3.5.4: employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts
Requirement 3.5.5: prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period
Requirement 3.5.6: disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity
Requirement 3.5.7: enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created
Requirement 3.5.8: prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations
Requirement 3.5.9: allow temporary password use for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password
Requirement 3.5.10: store and transmit only cryptographically protected passwords
Password lifetime restrictions do not apply to temporary passwords

must_not_extract: the running head (SP 800-171, REVISION 2, PROTECTING CONTROLLED UNCLASSIFIED INFORMATION) and the CHAPTER THREE PAGE 25 footer
the repeated pointer that SP 800-63-3 provides guidance on digital identities
the DISCUSSION paragraphs, which explain why a requirement exists rather than stating one
